summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria covered; 8 browser checks + 6 backend test files (10 pytest cases), all passing.

checks.criterion: Homepage loads with industrial dark/amber theme and live workshop stats
checks.name: homepage-loads-stats-no-console-errors
checks.evidence: Hero/stats rendered '5,480+', '22+ Years', '45 Mins' from /api/stats; zero console errors captured.

checks.name: language-toggle-switches-copy
checks.evidence: Toggled EN<->HI on / and /owner; nav-estimator and owner-login-button text matched Devanagari range in HI and reverted in EN.

checks.criterion: Cost Estimator produces a quote and submits a lead
checks.name: cost-estimator-submits-lead
checks.evidence: Selected equipment+HP, estimator-total-price showed numeric range; POST /api/leads -> 200, id LEAD-F40D13F5 shown in UI.

checks.criterion: Cost Estimator produces a quote and submits a lead (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_cost_estimator_lead.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/leads 200 -> id starts with LEAD-, status=new; missing service_type -> 422.

checks.name: emergency-dispatch-submits
checks.evidence: Filled SOS modal, POST /api/emergency-dispatch -> 200, ticket id SOS-xxxx rendered with hotline confirmation.

checks.name: test_tscheck_emergency_dispatch.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/emergency-dispatch 200 -> id starts with SOS-, status=dispatched, eta_minutes>0; missing fields -> 422.

checks.criterion: Job Status Tracker looks up a real job
checks.name: job-tracker-lookup-valid-and-invalid
checks.evidence: AE-2024-8901 shows Alok Agrawal / 50 HP 3-Phase Induction Motor timeline; invalid id shows job-not-found panel (404 logged, handled gracefully).

checks.name: owner-pin-login-and-tabs
checks.evidence: Wrong PIN 0000 -> 'Incorrect PIN' toast, stays on login form; PIN 2003 -> quotes/emergency/jobs/photos tabs and stat cards visible.

checks.name: test_tscheck_owner_pin_login.py
checks.evidence: POST /auth/owner-login {pin:2003} -> 200 authenticated=true, /auth/me confirms session; wrong pin -> 401 and /leads stays 401/403.

checks.criterion: Owner can advance a job stage
checks.name: owner-can-advance-job-stage
checks.evidence: Created isolated tscheck- job via POST /api/jobs, clicked owner-advance-<job_id>; POST /api/jobs/{id}/advance -> 200, dashboard card refetched to new %/stage.

checks.criterion: Owner can advance a job stage (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_job_advance.py
checks.evidence: Owner-authed POST /api/jobs/{tscheck_job}/advance -> 200, status_percentage increased; unauthenticated call -> 401/403. Never touched seeded AE-2024-8901.

checks.criterion: Owner can update before/after site photos
checks.name: owner-updates-site-photos-reflects-on-homepage
checks.evidence: PUT /api/settings/media -> 200 with new tscheck- marked captions/urls; homepage before-after-section shows updated after_caption.

checks.criterion: Owner can update before/after site photos (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_settings_media.py
checks.evidence: Owner-authed PUT /api/settings/media -> 200, GET /api/settings/media reflects update; unauthenticated PUT -> 401/403.
